_about: Real OpenEMR 8.5.0 FHIR output for Synthea patients with seeded edge cases (deploy/local/seed_edge_cases.php), captured 2026-09-17. Synthetic only. E1 uncoded penicillin allergy + amoxicillin; E2 metformin, K 6.4, eGFR 24, creatinine series; E3 injection text in allergy name; E4 clopidogrel + ibuprofen. Labs trimmed to >= 2025-03-17 plus all creatinine (LOINC 2160-0); encounters to latest 12.
